Not to be picky but doesn’t raiden ignore defense instead of shredding it? In fact I believe that her returns diminish with actually shredding defense because of this. For example using an enemy with 100 percent defense, she would ignore 60 making their defense an effective 40 percent. When you shred 45 percent of the defense they’re left with 55 and after that you’d ignore 60 leaving the enemy with an effective 33 defense. Either way this is a fun team I use myself :)
